name: Zodiac Ventures Limited
about: Zodiac Ventures Limited operates as a real estate development company in India. It engages in the construction or redevelopment of slum areas, cessed buildings by housing societies, and old buildings belonging to Municipal Corporation. The company was formerly known as Money Masters Investment Ltd. and changed its name to Zodiac Ventures Limited in June 2010. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.
